references.text: The Levites were to camp around the tabernacle to protect it, establishing the principle of the Levites' camp placement.
The tabernacle and the Levites' camp were placed in the center of Israel's camp, showing the central location of the sanctuary.
Moses and Aaron camped on the east side of the tabernacle, illustrating how the various groups were positioned around the sanctuary.
The description of the tabernacle that the Gershonites were to camp behind and be responsible for carrying.
The specific service and responsibility of the Gershonites regarding the tabernacle's curtains and coverings.
The Gershonites received carts and oxen for their service in transporting the parts of the tabernacle.
